content.comment_body: Hello, I want to set the RTC time to +3:30 but that option is not available, only +3 or +4 are present. Thank you.
Hi [user_name], Which version of [product_name] do you have? For reference, the attachment shows that version [article_no] includes RTC and an astronomical clock.
Setting the time to +3:30 is not possible.
It makes no difference if you have [product_name] [version_no] or other similar versions. The time zone cannot be set to +3:30; only full-hour selections are offered.

analysis.insight_summary: Users cannot configure custom RTC time zones with half-hour increments on [product_name] hardware. Only full-hour options are available, which limits flexibility for international users in regions where the local time offset is not a whole hour.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to set the RTC time zone to +3:30 and adjust for specific local time requirements.
